_comment: State of record for the auto-refresh pipeline. One entry per source. 'latest_period' (YYYYMM) is the newest edition already ingested into the derived tables; the resolver compares the live publication against it to decide whether to run. BEFORE first use, set each 'latest_period' to the true current value so the pipeline only fires on the NEXT release. 'expected_practices_min/max' feed the validation gate that catches silent practice drops (see PANEL_NOTES corrupt-CSV incident).
